notes: Versioned taxonomy for the customer-ask scout (Surface 58). Bump customer_ask_taxonomy_version on ANY category/keyword change so cached classifications invalidate. The classifier decides whether a customer signal (inbox message or review text) is an explicit NEW-PRODUCT request. `ask_keywords` are NOT used to classify — they feed the deterministic evidence cross-check in customer_ask_scout.py that flags an item when the LLM says is_ask=true but zero ask-keyword is present (a confidently-wrong positive). `not_a_new_product` phrases distinguish variant/logistics questions about an EXISTING product from a genuine new-product request. Keep both lists short and high-precision.

categories.product_request: An explicit request for a NEW duck subject/theme we do not currently sell — a character, animal, breed, sports team, profession, hobby, or motif the customer wants made into a duck.
categories.variant_request: A question about an EXISTING product's variant (color, size, quantity) — not a new product. Routes to ops, never mints a concept.
categories.not_a_request: Praise, thanks, logistics (shipping/refund/order status), complaint, or unrelated chatter — no product-concept signal.
categories.ambiguous: Unclear whether it is a genuine new-product request — flag needs_review, never mint.
